build_word_seq_embedding_from_config: build a WordSeqEmbedding instance from a Config object and tensorizer with optional pretrained embeddings
create_word_seq_embedding_with_pretraine: create a WordSeqEmbedding initialized with pretrained embedding weights from a file path
run_forward_pass_word_seq_embedding: run the forward pass on token indices and counts to get sequence embeddings
freeze_word_embedding_parameters: freeze the word embedding layer parameters to prevent gradient updates during training
visualize_word_embedding_tensorboard: visualize word embeddings in TensorBoard using a SummaryWriter with vocabulary metadata
